description: Canonical inventory of existing CapCut text animations. Animation ZIPs are stored locally and on Telegram; previews are stored in the public Git preview repository.

metadataGuide.effectId: PRIMARY KEY. Never add another animation with an effectId already present. This is also the app cache directory and Telegram proxy key.
metadataGuide.resourceId: Secondary unique key. Keep the original CapCut resourceId; do not replace it with effectId unless the source really uses the same value.
metadataGuide.name: Display name from the CapCut animation catalog.
metadataGuide.category: Exactly one of In, Out, or Loop.
metadataGuide.archive.localPath: Absolute local ZIP path when the archive is mirrored on disk.
metadataGuide.archive.bytes: Exact ZIP size; the Android asset store verifies it.
metadataGuide.archive.sha256: SHA-256 of the ZIP. A duplicate SHA is a content warning, not automatically an effectId error.
metadataGuide.telegram.fileId: Bot-API file_id used by the local asset proxy.
metadataGuide.telegram.fileUniqueId: Stable Telegram file identity; must not be reused by another animation.
metadataGuide.preview.rawUrl: Animated WebP URL served by the public preview repository.
metadataGuide.thumb.rawUrl: Static thumbnail URL served by Git.

duplicatePolicy.archive.sha256: warn: identical bytes may exist under several CapCut effect IDs; inspect before reusing or deleting

addAssetChecklist: Confirm effectId is not present in items.
Confirm resourceId is not present in duplicateGroups.resourceId.
Confirm Telegram fileUniqueId is not already registered.
Confirm local path is not already registered.
Compute ZIP bytes and SHA-256; compare with archiveSha256 warnings.
Use category exactly as In, Out, or Loop.
Add preview and thumb URLs after the Telegram upload succeeds.
Run this generator again and require blockingConflicts to remain empty.
